diagnosis: The site has a strong foundational structure with rich calculator functionality, 18 article pages, solid Schema markup, ad placements, and a brand-consistent classical design system. However, four critical usability barriers directly suppress PV: (1) The back-to-top button exists on every page via inline HTML but is broken everywhere except bra-size-calculator because no JavaScript toggles its opacity/pointer-events — this removes a key re-engagement loop on 95% of pages; (2) On articles/index.html the two desktop breakpoints (768px, 1024px) are missing closing braces while the mobile breakpoint has an extra one, producing a CSS parse error that silently collapses the 2-column and 3-column grid layouts on tablets/desktops, severely reducing click-through to article detail pages; (3) A dangling bare <meta> tag with no name/content attributes sits on articles/index.html line 15, which can confuse lightweight parsers and wastes a byte in the critical head; (4) Two duplicate Print buttons appear in the celebration card action row in bra-size-calculator/index.html, which confuses users about which action fires. Together these issues silently degrade navigation flow, content discovery, and form clarity across the highest-traffic pages.

patch_list.issue: Two unclosed @media blocks for 768px and 1024px breakpoints leave the .articles-grid desktop layouts at 1 column instead of 2 or 3. This silently collapses content discovery on tablet and desktop, reducing article click-through and subsequent tool pages — directly suppressing multi-page PV per session.
patch_list.goal: Restore 2-column (tablet) and 3-column (desktop) article grid layouts so visitors can scan more guides per scroll, increasing clicks into sub-pages and overall PV.

patch_list.issue: A bare <meta> tag without name/content (line 15) is invalid HTML. It contributes no value and slightly inflates the critical head block. Cleaner head improves parse speed and avoids obscure browser quirks.
patch_list.old_snippet:
<meta http-equiv="Cache-Control" content="no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate"/>
    <meta>
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover, maximum-scale=5"/>
patch_list.new_snippet:
<meta http-equiv="Cache-Control" content="no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate"/>
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover, maximum-scale=5"/>
patch_list.goal: Remove invalid markup from the critical render path for a cleaner, faster head.

patch_list.issue: The floating back-to-top button (#footerBackToTop) is present in HTML with opacity:0 and pointer-events:none, but no JavaScript on this page ever adds the scroll-driven class to make it visible. Visitors on the calculator page (the #1 traffic driver) cannot scroll back up quickly, harming retention and repeat visits.
patch_list.old_snippet:
<button id="footerBackToTop" class="fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-[#fdf8f5] border border-[#e6d5c3] text-[#8b7355] hover:text-[#6b5344] hover:border-[#6b5344] shadow-md flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-300 opacity-0 pointer-events-none" aria-label="Back to top">
      <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
        <polyline points="18 15 12 9 6 15"></polyline>
      </svg>
    </button>
patch_list.new_snippet:
<button id="footerBackToTop" class="fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-[#fdf8f5] border border-[#e6d5c3] text-[#8b7355] hover:text-[#6b5344] hover:border-[#6b5344] shadow-md flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-300 opacity-0 pointer-events-none" aria-label="Back to top">
      <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
        <polyline points="18 15 12 9 6 15"></polyline>
      </svg>
    </button>
    <script>!function(){var b=document.getElementById('footerBackToTop');if(!b)return;var show=function(){b.classList.toggle('bc-back-to-top-visible',window.scrollY>600);};window.addEventListener('scroll',show,{passive:true});show();b.addEventListener('click',function(){window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});});}();</script>
patch_list.goal: Make the back-to-top button functional on the calculator page, letting visitors quickly return to the form for repeat calculations — a key retention loop that directly lifts PV per session.

patch_list.issue: Two identical Print buttons (both data-bc-action="print") appear in the celebration card actions row (lines 353 and 356). One is styled as primary but both fire the same action. This confuses users about whether the second button does something different, reducing confidence in the result UI.
